payload.text: Client names and Intent's committed record (vc, 2026-11-10; not yet ruled by hv). Intent's repository is public and is mirrored to the third remote (watchout 33), so from ST0092 on vc has kept a client's name and its initiatives' names out of committed prose: a client tree is called that, and a client's swarm is "a swarm". Two things predate the caution. Ten event files of October 2026 name one client supervisor's session. And vc's own boot commit of 2026-11-10, c1d7d163d, names four client sessions in its message and is unpushed. vc asked hv on 2026-11-10 whether client names stay out and what becomes of that message, and hv has not answered: the answer is owed before the push of main (hold 8). Refs under refs/bank are local, are not pushed, and may name them; refs/bank/vc/st0092/spike-form-v1.md does.
